snippet.title: Emoji Massacre - Multiplayer Boxing
snippet.description: Top-down emoji boxing with real fight-night drama: ring walks, cut men, judges' cards and a crowd that boos when you stall. 50+ emoji fighters with matching gloves and signature specials. Career, online versus, local 2P, Pay-Per-View and daily gauntlets. Jab, parry, bleed, beat the count.
